Conflict against `main` resolved by **merge commit** `6560e0f60` (no rebase, no amend, no force-push). `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main 6560e0f60` now exits **0**, against both `d3bf4fa6f` and the newer `7fc5c3c127`; the GitHub API reports `mergeable: true`.

**Two files, both append-collisions with PR #7022, both sides kept.**

`packages/test-support/src/index.ts` — the barrel now carries the union:

```ts
export { enumOptions, shapeEnumOptions } from './spec-enum-options';
/* ...#7022's docblock... */
export { ZOD_WRAPPER_KEYS } from './zod-wrapper-keys';
```

`packages/test-support/README.md` — this branch's rewritten `spec-enum-options.ts` entry AND #7022's two `zod-wrapper-keys` entries, in `main`'s ordering.

One sentence was **corrected rather than kept verbatim**, and it is worth naming because it is the one place a "keep both sides" resolution would have produced a false statement. This branch's text said the other censused reader classes, *"array-element unwrapping, the wrapper-key walk — are NOT confined here yet and are still hand-copied"*. #7022 made the wrapper-key half false. The merged sentence carries #7022's fact and this branch's surviving half:

> Of the other Zod-internals reader classes #5872 censused, the wrapper-key list is now shared as DATA (below, objectui#6923); array-element unwrapping is NOT confined here yet and is still hand-copied.

`pnpm-lock.yaml` auto-merged with no markers, and `pnpm install` left it byte-unchanged, so it needed no regeneration and none was hand-written.

| check | result |
|---|---|
| `pnpm exec vitest run packages/test-support/` + all 16 converted sites + the 4 class-(1) consumers + #7022's 3 touched suites | `Test Files 27 passed (27)` / `Tests 399 passed, 1 skipped (400)` |
| `pnpm exec vitest run scripts/` | `Test Files 91 passed (91)` / `Tests 2582 passed (2582)` — 91, up from 90, because #7022's `zod-wrapper-keys.shared.test.ts` is now in the tree and green here |

| `node scripts/check-control-bytes.mjs` | `OK (scanned 5834 tracked text file(s))` |

Diffs above were computed from the **merge-base**, never two-dot: `git diff $(git merge-base origin/main HEAD) HEAD` is 28 files, exactly this branch's own set plus the changeset — no foreign file rode in.
